messages.content: 依据查新点和任务生成任务语言概念目录。同组 terms 会按 OR 展开，每个词都应能代表该概念。仅在 needs_translation 为真时给出来源语言 comparison。检查机制、参与者、操作及其关系是否得到覆盖。

任务输入
{"point": {"point_id": "NP-1", "claim": "提出Attention U-Net，将可学习的注意力门加入U-Net，抑制无关区域并突出医学图像中的目标结构。", "claim_en": "", "technical_features": ["注意力门学习抑制无关区域并突出任务相关特征。", "结合输入激活与来自更粗尺度的门控信号计算注意力系数。", "使用注意力系数缩放输入特征，以支持目标结构分割。"], "technical_features_en": [], "source_locations": ["assets/papers/07-Attention-UNet.pdf#page=1", "assets/papers/07-Attention-UNet.pdf#page=4"]}, "task": {"task_id": "corpus-07-Attention-UNet-NP-1-A-1-zh", "novelty_point_id": "NP-1", "task_type": "literature_search", "language": "zh", "description": "", "attempt": 1}, "limits": {"max_concepts": 6, "max_terms_per_concept": 5, "max_alias_per_concept": 4, "max_exclude_per_concept": 3, "max_term_words": 8, "require_escape": false}, "needs_translation": false}
